notes: Performance - Specifications (Continued), printed page v: MAXIMUM WEIGHT Ramp 3110 POUNDS, Takeoff 3100 POUNDS, Landing 2950 POUNDS; STANDARD EMPTY WEIGHT 1924 POUNDS; MAXIMUM USEFUL LOAD 1186 POUNDS.
The handbook computes maximum useful load against maximum ramp weight (3110 lb), not maximum takeoff weight (3100 lb): 3110 - 1924 = 1186.
Standard empty weight is the handbook figure for a standard-equipped airplane. Each airplane's own weighed basic empty weight, from its weight-and-balance record, governs.
corrections_applied: FD-760 (2026-09-26): empty_weight 2010 -> 1924 and useful_load 1090 -> 1186. The previous figures cited no handbook.
